title: Live Evidence Operations Cycle 001
summary: Operate the September evidence calendar as independent dated decisions, beginning with a bounded Louisiana Starlink No Material Change receipt on September 1.
record_scope: Append-only Phase 165–172 evidence-to-publication overlay over immutable Phase 156 and Phase 164 validation receipts.
publication_boundaries: This is an append-only operating and content layer over the immutable Phase 156 and Phase 164 receipts; it does not rewrite either validated baseline.
Only evidence checks lawful on or before 2026-09-01 may carry a decision. Later September and October outcomes remain null until their recorded dates.

Candidate sources, planned capacity, service availability, offers, forecasts, and adjacent facts do not substitute for the exact observation, authority, period, method, and denominator required by a gate.
No owner decision, project or place stage, admitted longitudinal series, causal result, score, rank, repository publication, hosted deployment, or v1 promotion is inferred.

current_decision_receipt.prior_state: ConnectLA’s June 11 grant-agreement record described planned Starlink access for 10,635 eligible locations in more than 50 parishes by the end of summer; the adoption signal remained In Review pending observed installations or subscriptions for a fixed eligible-location cohort with a dated period and disclosed method.
current_decision_receipt.current_state: The adoption signal remains In Review. The September 1 review confirms the award baseline and identifies adjacent Pecan Island planned-service and affordability details, but no reviewed official surface supplies a compatible observed installation or subscription result for the fixed Louisiana BEAD cohort.
current_decision_receipt.bounded_finding: ConnectLA’s current official surfaces continue to establish planned access for 10,635 locations. Adjacent official material describes a 270-home-and-business Pecan Island plan and a Vermilion Parish discount; none reports actual installations, subscriptions, take-up, an observation period, or a compatible cohort method.
current_decision_receipt.evidence_boundary: This receipt is limited to the official public surfaces reviewed on September 1. It does not establish that a qualifying artifact does not exist, that no household subscribed, or that the program succeeded or failed. Planned coverage, an affordability offer, availability, and provider-wide subscriber totals cannot substitute for observed Louisiana BEAD-cohort adoption.
current_decision_receipt.publication_effect: Publish a dated No Material Change decision, retain the signal In Review, append the bounded finding to the assigned reader surfaces, and keep Git-backed release validation separate from the evidence decision.
current_decision_receipt.exact_next_artifact: A ConnectLA- or SpaceX-issued project return that fixes the eligible-location cohort and reports actual installations, subscriptions, or service taken with observation period and method.
current_decision_receipt.next_check_boundary: The September 8 date is a bounded public-surface recheck after the draft template’s August reporting interval. The template does not prove the executed SpaceX terms, report delivery, or public availability.
